concept.concept: Illustrated Halloween-ified houseplants — a cactus with tiny ghost costume, a monstera with bat wings — and 'My Plants Are Dying For Attention'
concept.audience: Millennial and Gen Z plant enthusiasts who layer their hobby identity with Halloween humor
concept.rationale: Plant parent identity is massive online. Halloween crossover content performs extremely well in this demographic. The tote is a natural fit for carrying plants home from nurseries. Pun is sharp and shareable. Falls perfectly in the pre-Halloween gifting surge.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "My Plants Are Dying For Attention" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of three Halloween-themed houseplants arranged in a row on a plain cream background. Left: a round barrel cactus with a tiny white ghost costume draped over it, ghost has two black dot eyes. Center: a large monstera deliciosa with bright green leaves and attached black bat wings on either side, wings have simple geometric details. Right: a potted snake plant with orange and purple striped wrapping around its leaves like a mummy, simple black X eyes. All plants in terracotta pots. Solid color blocks only—no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Limited palette: cream background, sage green, terracotta orange, black, white, purple. High contrast. Single centered composition with generous margins. Text in bold retro serif font arched below the plants.
